lesson: Proof freshness is not the same as self-referential commit identity. The durable pattern is to attest to an exact pre-record state and verify that state from the proof-bearing record's parent with sufficient history available to the verifier. If later repository work advances main before the final proof record is written, the proof scope must be rebound to the actual immediate parent rather than relying on an older checkpoint SHA.
